homemade.costume: a simple homemade Halloween costume of your own invention, pieced together from everyday household materials
homemade.props: one small homemade prop of your own choosing that suits the costume

vampire.costume: a vampire costume: a black cape with a tall stiff red-lined collar
props: a miniature gold medallion on a ribbon
a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hooked over one wing

gargoyle.costume: a gargoyle costume: a stone-gray hood with two small stubby horns and little bat wings
props: a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hooked over one wing

eagle.costume: a needle-felted bald eagle costume: a fuzzy white felted-wool hood framing its face, a hooked yellow felt eagle beak on the hood's brow above the pigeon's own, and a chocolate-brown felted body wrap with layered felt feathers
props: a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hooked over one wing

ghost.costume: a small white bedsheet ghost costume with two cut-out eye holes, draped over its back with the head poking through
props: a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hooked over one wing
a miniature black top hat

phantom.costume: a Phantom of the Opera costume: a white porcelain half mask and a black opera cape with a red satin lining
props: a miniature black top hat
a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hooked over one wing

witch.costume: a witch costume: a tall pointed black witch hat and a tattered black cape
props: a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hooked over one wing
a miniature eye patch
a small purple satin bow at the neck
a small black-and-orange striped scarf

pirate.costume: a pirate costume: a black tricorn hat with gold trim and a small striped sash
props: a miniature eye patch
a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hooked over one wing

scarecrow.costume: a scarecrow costume: a frayed straw hat and a patched burlap vest with straw poking out of the seams
props: a red plaid bandana knotted at the neck
a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hooked over one wing
captions: If I Only Had a Brain

pumpkin.costume: a round orange pumpkin costume with a green stem cap
props: a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hooked over one wing
a little collar of green felt pumpkin leaves

plague.costume: a plague doctor costume: a small black wide-brimmed hat, a long black waxed-canvas cloak, and a white leather beaked plague mask that covers its whole face, the mask's long curved beak in place of the pigeon's own, with round glass eyepieces
props: a tiny wooden walking cane tucked under one wing
a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hooked over one wing
captions: The Doctor Will Coo You Now

bee.costume: a bumblebee costume: a hand-knitted yellow-and-black striped bodysuit with visible chunky stitches, a headband with two springy antennae tipped with yellow pom-poms, and small translucent mesh wings on its back
props: a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hooked over one wing
a small felt sunflower pinned at the neck
captions: To Bee or Not to Bee

skeleton.costume: a black skeleton onesie with white printed bones
props: a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hooked over one wing
a small black-and-orange striped scarf
